Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Zirconium (Zr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a club outfit — a body-hugging bodycon dress with geometric cut-outs at the waist and a low back — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.

RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.

PROP: with her own right hand she drinks from a water bottle; it is all she holds.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — zirconium: a hard, corrosion-proof silver-grey metal named from a Persian word for gold-coloured, after the golden zircon gems of Ceylon in which it was found in 1789; zircon grains lock in uranium but shut out lead as they crystallize, so they keep time, and tiny grains from red Australian hills are about 4.4 billion years old, the oldest memories of the first solid Earth; zircon is also gathered from beach sands; melted zirconia grows into cubic zirconia, a flawless stone that throws even more rainbow fire than the diamond it imitates; the metal lets neutrons pass and so clads reactor fuel, once its near-identical twin hafnium is removed — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
